doc.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003

title: Closing and WKCR's troubles
summary: Thanks, a joke about WKCR's mistreatment, and apology for talking too much.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Oh gosh well. That’s saying a lot. And you know I really hope that — we’ll have to get together again. I come to New York on occasion.
And I really wish I could pick up your radio station where we live.

Yeah well we’re having a lot of problems, you know, we were in the World Trade Center and I’ll leave something on the record here because I feel that strongly about it, but I’ll make it a joke. I’ll close with a joke. Some jazz musicians like to do that. WKCR has been mistreated by Columbia University, the FCC and Osama Bin Laden and Bin Laden is in third place.
All right. Enough said. Well maybe next time around we’ll understand why. Well I want to thank you for all the things you’ve done in this business.
Why thank you. Did you get what you wanted for your thing?
Okay well did I talk too much then? I apologize, that’s one of my trademarks. You proved that I’m me.
